company.name: Protege
company.shortDescription: Protege is the AI training data platform enabling seamless and compliant data exchange.
company.description: Protege is a company that provides a data layer for AI training. The company enables the ethical sourcing of hard-to-find, multimodal, and real-world AI training data. Protege also helps data holders monetize underutilized data assets.
company.headquarters: New City, New York, United States

productsAndServices.description: A platform for sourcing, licensing, curating, and delivering proprietary real-world datasets for AI model pre-training, post-training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and benchmarking.
productsAndServices.name: Protege AI Training Data Platform

productsAndServices.description: A managed service that translates model-development requirements into qualified, de-identified, linked, standardized, and purpose-built datasets for training or evaluation.
productsAndServices.name: Custom AI Dataset Curation and Delivery

productsAndServices.description: A catalog and curation service providing de-identified, multimodal healthcare data for AI development, including EHR, claims, clinical text, imaging, pathology, documents, audio, and genomics.
productsAndServices.name: Protege Healthcare Data

productsAndServices.description: Benchmark-specific real-world datasets designed to evaluate healthcare AI models using uncontaminated, representative, and multimodal data from clinical settings.
productsAndServices.name: Protege Evaluation Datasets and Benchmarks

productsAndServices.description: A collection and curation service for egocentric video, motion capture, 3D scans, digital twins, game data, and physical-interaction data used to develop robotics and world models.
productsAndServices.name: Protege Spatial & Physical Intelligence Data

productsAndServices.description: A rights-managed service that licenses audiovisual content and prepares it for AI training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and benchmarking while preserving ownership and usage restrictions.
productsAndServices.name: Protege Video Data Licensing
